recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future desire to restore profile-specific example tabs or alter current navigation should be handled by a current profiling/navigation Jira rather than by changing this DSTU1 categorization audit.
issue_request: FHIR-5449 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I DSTU1 ballot comment asking that old profile examples material be split or better distinguished between profiles describing translated artifacts, such as US Lab or CDA R2 profiles, and specific examples such as the lipid profile. The recorded resolution was to categorize them better.
initial_application: No exact FHIR-5449-tagged source commit was found. The likely historical application appears in 2015 profile/implementation-guide publication work: commit 1e71f3b1 introduced source/igs.xml and retained the generated profile list, while commits such as 96a2d4e3 and bc85aea0 refined IG metadata, sections, and registry presentation around that profile-list surface.
additional_context: The current build no longer has a source/profile-examples.html page matching the old Jira related URL. Current source exposes source/profilelist.html as the generated profiles/extensions list and separately links source/profiling-examples.html from profiling guidance for slicing/discriminator examples. Old artifacts named in the comment are not active current-build profile entries: US Lab is commented out in source/igs.xml and the CDA profile is commented out in source/fhir.ini.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Reintroducing or splitting the obsolete profile-examples page would be unnecessary because current build-scope navigation already separates profile/IG listings from profiling examples.
